issue.title: Pull requests are not longer linked to issues

repository.name: hive-mind
repository.description: The AI that controls AIs to do the automation of automation.

issue.body:
See https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/pull/326 that was not linked to https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/issues/322, also we must guarantee we always address issue fully, not part of it. Everything that is required in the issue must be fully done in a single pull request, we might need to check our system prompt and all other prompts to ensure we increase probability of models to fully address the requested issue, as it also critical part of the system it must be impossible to merge pull request without addressing all requirements from the issue. We should try to set the goal for Codex and other tools that support goal and the goal is simple - don't stop until all requirements of the issue are fully done in the widest scope possible.

We have critical regression, previously we made a guarantee that updated the pull request description to ensure pull request always linked to issue. And also when we solve all open issues we must link exactly all of them, and if some issues are not properly linked, we must update the description using solve command, to ensure all issues are linked.

Double check all relevant code for regressions and deliver fixes. Find root cause of regression introduced, and make sure it will not ever happen again, we must cover everything 100% with tests, and ensure no regressions possible in the future, as this is critical requirement.

We need to download all logs and data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), in which we will reconstruct timeline/sequence of events, list of each and all requirements from the issue, find root causes of the each problem, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

If there is not enough data to find actual root cause, add debug output and verbose mode if not present, that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration.

If issue related to any other repository/project, where we can report issues on GitHub, please do so. Each issue must contain reproducible examples, workarounds and suggestions for fix the issue in code. Also double check to fully apply requirements to entire codebase, so if we have issue in multiple places, it should be fixed in all them.

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.

issue.title: fix: expose failed process status to models and tool streams

repository.name: agent
repository.description: Thin agent based on OpenCode CLI (without TUI)

issue.body:
A failed command now exposes its exit status in the text sent to the model. A quiet `false` returns `Exit code 1\n` with an error flag; `true` retains its empty successful output. Commands exiting 4 can no longer deliver authentication instructions as a successful lookup.

Fixes #317.

## Changes

- Use AI SDK `error-text` results so Anthropic receives `is_error: true` and OpenAI-compatible providers receive the exit status in their tool message.
- Preserve exit metadata and attachments in failed session states, history replay, stream-json events, and batch accounting.
- Apply status formatting to user shell commands, command-template substitutions, and ripgrep execution errors while preserving successful output and ordinary no-match searches.
- Fix cancellation before completion listeners are installed and terminate children that ignore SIGTERM after their shell exits. Add optional process completion diagnostics.
- Mirror failure flags, exit prefixes, timeout metadata, and batch handling in Rust. Add JavaScript and Rust patch release entries.
- Merge the latest `main`, including PR #326 and release 0.26.9. Keep its parser compatibility changes, permission tests, packed-package CI check, and newer dependency resolutions. Both lockfiles match `main`.

## Reproduction and regression tests

Invoke the bash tool with `false`, or a command that prints `Please run gh auth login` and exits 4. Previously, the provider received only empty text or the authentication instructions.

`js/tests/process-tool-status.ts` verifies failure/success, timeout, cancellation, signals, truncation, Anthropic request conversion, batch accounting, history, and attachments. `js/tests/host-config-contract.ts` inspects actual requests to a local OpenAI-compatible provider and both stream-json formats. `rust/tests/tool_bash.rs` verifies the Rust failure, success, timeout, and batch behavior. The original reproducing checks failed before implementation.

## Validation

- JavaScript suite: **829 passed, 4 existing todo, 0 failed**.
- Rust suite: **436 passed, 0 failed** across 83 targets.
- Packed bash parser matrix: **4 passed** with each of web-tree-sitter 0.25.10 and 0.27.0.
- ESLint, Prettier, file-size checks, changeset validation, frozen Bun installation, Rust formatting, and Clippy pass. Clippy retains the existing warnings in `tool/glob.rs` and `tests/tool_read.rs`.
- npm security audit passes its high-severity threshold; two existing low-severity Babel/OpenTUI findings remain. Dependency freshness passes with the documented Solid and web-tree-sitter compatibility pins.

Investigation details: [issue #317 case study](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/blob/issue-317-8f1ad88e11e3/docs/case-studies/issue-317/README.md).

The [first post-merge changeset check](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/actions/runs/36705081502/job/109853314575) rejected two release entries (saved log lines 471–476). Combining the process-status note into the existing changeset satisfies the repository's exactly-one rule; the same validator now passes locally and in CI.

All checks pass on commit `1ec26a8982bfdcac2e34a6cf7116a7155d2a487d`: [JavaScript pipeline](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/actions/runs/36705405598), [Rust pipeline](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/actions/runs/36705405407), [security and CodeQL](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/actions/runs/36705405379), and [link checks](https://github.com/link-assistant/agent/actions/runs/36705405273). Tests pass on all configured platforms; release jobs are skipped for pull requests.
